AI is moving at the speed of light. We can move at the speed of thought.

WHY NOW

AI-fluency is the baseline.

AI is reshaping every job function, disrupting some, collapsing others, expanding the rest.

Economic mobility now depends on professionals committing to becoming AI-native.

Those most fluent in AI will drive organizational transformation, and peer-to-peer learning is one of the fastest paths to that fluency.

BERG is making sure our community is on the right side of the future job market.

WHAT BERG IS

BERG unites professionals committed to providing connection, professional development, and economic empowerment for each other.

A network of professionals from 50+ companies, including Amazon, NBA, PepsiCo, Fortune, Disney, and Squarespace, with diverse representation across business functions and levels.

Active programming: panels, fireside chats, and networking events aligned with our pillars of connection, professional development, and economic empowerment.

Recent activations: “Do The Right Thing: Financial Fluency Demystified” with Betterment, and “From Connection to Collection” with the Whitney Museum.
